title: Describe a wave
target: Identify amplitude, wavelength, frequency and period.

authoring.limitations: Reasoning evidence only. Multiple choice does not certify physical performance. Teacher reviews before assigning and rates mastery separately.

cpa.prompt: A point on a string reaches +7 mm and −7 mm relative to equilibrium. What is amplitude?
cpa.guide: Amplitude is maximum displacement from equilibrium, not peak-to-peak distance.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.

cpa.prompt: A trace has a peak-to-peak displacement of 18 cm about its midpoint. What is amplitude?
cpa.guide: Half the peak-to-peak displacement is the amplitude.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.

cpa.prompt: Successive crests on a wave are at x = 0.4 m and x = 1.3 m at the same instant. What is wavelength?
cpa.guide: Wavelength is separation between matching neighboring points: 1.3 − 0.4 = 0.9 m.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.

cpa.prompt: A crest and the nearest trough are separated by 0.35 m in a sinusoidal wave. What is wavelength?
cpa.guide: Neighboring crest-to-trough separation is half a wavelength.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.

cpa.prompt: A vibrating point completes 15 cycles in 3.0 s. What are frequency and period?
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.

cpa.prompt: A sensor trace repeats every 0.125 s. How many cycles occur in 2.0 s?
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.
